description.zh:
云盘访问协议类型：

- iscsi：标准云盘默认协议，rbd云盘和标准云盘都支持该协议。

 - rbd：rbd云盘默认协议，只有rbd云盘支持该挂载协议。
description.en:
The access protocol type for the disk:

- iscsi: The default protocol for standard disks. Both RBD disks and standard disks support this protocol.

- rbd: The default protocol for RBD disks. Only RBD disks support this mount protocol.

description.zh:
生产的共享盘磁盘类型：

- standard(标准云盘)。
- rbd（rbd云盘）。

> 
> - 不指定共享盘磁盘类型时默认生成标准云盘。
> - 仅母盘类型为rbd时支持生成rbd共享盘。
description.en:
The disk type of the generated shared disk:

- standard (standard disk).

- rbd (RBD disk).

> * If the shared disk type is not specified, a standard disk is generated by default.
>
> * RBD shared disks can be generated only when the parent disk type is RBD.

description.zh: 文件加载速率优化参数。

title.en: Mount an SDG to an instance

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens attach-instance-sdg --instance-ids aic-1 --sdg-id sdg-xxxx --disk-type standard --disk-access-protocol iscsi --load-opt CacheSize=20 BlockRwSplit=true BlockRwSplitSize=20 Cache=true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens AttachInstanceSDG --region cn-hangzhou --SDGId 'sdg-xxxx' --DiskType standard --LoadOpt '{"CacheSize":20,"BlockRwSplit":true,"BlockRwSplitSize":20,"Cache":true}' --DiskAccessProtocol iscsi --InstanceIds '["aic-1"]'
